run.change_description: [field] Sync controlled value changes with field state

summary.intent: Make Field.Control sync controlled value changes with field state through useValueChanged (controlled) and onChange (uncontrolled), fix dirty state for non-string values, honor details.cancel(), and stop rejected controlled values from reaching field state (caller-supplied PR #5460 text; no originating issue).
summary.issue_fit: Met — every stated outcome is implemented; issue alignment unavailable beyond the supplied PR text and commit message. The uncontrolled cancel path still updates dirty and filled, which follows the DOM and is noted as an observation.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff of both changed files reviewed with useValueChanged, useRegisterFieldControl, useFieldControlRegistration and useFieldValidation read; existing `FieldControl.test.tsx` run once at the head under jsdom: 26 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0. Chromium and rendered-output checks unavailable. Supplied CI bot comments (bundle size +88B, benchmarks on unrelated components) were not used as evidence. No risk area is touched, so no verifier was dispatched.

observations.fact: In uncontrolled mode a canceled change still updates dirty and filled before the cancel check, so only clearErrors and validation are skipped; this tracks the DOM value, which React cannot revert.
No added test asserts that a rejected or rewritten controlled value leaves dirty, filled and validity untouched, though the PR body promises it.
